How we print

Our minimum order is 25 copies and the standard turnaround is 14 days from approved artwork. Rush production runs to 5 days at a surcharge.

Text stock: 120 gsm uncoated wove as standard, with 150 gsm available on request. Cover stock: 300 gsm board with a matt laminate.

Trim size: 234 mm by 156 mm for hardbacks, and 198 mm by 129 mm for paperbacks. Spine width is calculated from the page count once the text is final.

Colour work is printed at 2400 dpi and proofed on the production stock rather than on a digital simulation, because the paper changes the result.

A typical hardback of 320 pages costs £14 per copy at 100 copies, falling to £9 per copy at 500 copies.

What is included

  • Layout check before printing
  • Bound proof for approval
  • Delivery to a single UK address
